notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood. Primary goal: embed an in-app assistant + unified doc search; improve onboarding/help using summarization. Initial run on Hosted API to validate latency/cost and then move to Dedicated behind VPC for production.

Sales/POC context: Jordan Kline (AE) intro'd 2026-02-18. CTO (Marta Ruiz) emphasized: "cannot go to dedicated without SOC2 Type II and SSO/SAML + tenant-level audit logs". Product PM (Caleb Zhou) is driving latency SLAs (p95 < 250ms for short chat completions) and cost target ~ $0.0006/token equivalent for embeddings pipeline.

Security & infra notes: Security wants evidence of SOC2 Type II report, architecture diagram for Private control plane, KMS integration pattern (customer-managed keys preferred), audit log retention controls (need ability to set retention to 12 months min, legal team asked about 24 months), and data residency into US-only regions. Network requires VPC peering diagram + port/IAM matrix before Dedicated kickoff.

POC plan: Phase 1 (Hosted) - 2 weeks smoke: chat + embeddings on 10k monthly users sim traffic, measure latency, token costs. Phase 2 (Dedicated pilot) - isolated GPU pool (2x A10-ish nodes), canary routes + KV caching. Success metrics: latency p95 < 300ms under target concurrency, 10% cost improvement via batching/caching suggestions.

Pricing convo: discussed committed capacity pricing ranges; AE proposed $60k/yr committed baseline with burst credits. Finance wants formal quote for CFO sign-off.

Quotes/scratch: "We like Redwood's fallback model routing idea — useful if a dedicated variant is down. But compliance is the gating factor." — Marta Ruiz (CTO).

Misc: referenced artifacts attached (pricing deck + VPC sketch). Fireflies transcripts available for 2 calls. Legal NDA in progress (sending today).
